name: @opensa/perfect-cutscene-asi
description: Our own .asi for real GTA:SA 1.0 US: gives CUTSCENE vehicle clumps the deferred, depth-sorted alpha pass the engine grants only gameplay CVehicle entities, so window glass composites over scene actors at any entity draw order. Cross-compiled macOS→Win32 (MinGW-w64), tested under Wine.

scripts.build:asi: npm run gen && make clean && make APPLY=1
scripts.build:verify: npm run gen && make clean && make
scripts.build:debug: npm run gen && make clean && make APPLY=1 DEBUG=1
